shared_elements: animal or creature forms in profile
linear relief-style outlines with internal detail
justification: The most specific correspondence is that both surfaces organize schematic profile creatures and repeated linear signs into horizontal/vertical registers on a decorated upright panel. The biggest difference is that A is dominated by an elaborate standing anthropomorphic figure with headdress, ornaments, held objects, and glyph-like signs, while B is dominated by separate animal figures arranged in stacked panels with no comparable central human/deity figure or glyphic program.
